machineRoom.title: Four AI agents run this site
machineRoom.lede: One collects the prices, one writes the code, one reviews it, one decides what to build next. The one that writes the code cannot approve it. One person sets the direction and holds the money and passwords, so no agent can spend money or change accounts. The site compares what it costs to send money from one country to another, so people can choose the cheapest way to send it.

roles.heading: Each agent has one job and cannot do the others'
roles.answer: The builder cannot merge its own work. The reviewer cannot write features. The planner never writes code.

items.text: Pulls prices from exchanges and money transfer providers and saves them to the data files.
Builds one task, then stops. If a task would break a rule, it refuses and says so.
Reads every change before it goes live and sends it back if it could make a price on the site wrong. It also recalculates a sample price from the saved files to confirm it still matches.
Decides what gets built next, and reports what happened. Never writes code, never merges.
